text:
Samir Rao: FYI NexaHealth renewal in 8 days. They want to rebaseline from 150k -> 320k tokens/mo and asked for 15% across the committed tier. Also asked for a 30d on-prem POC for data locality.

Priya Shah: Do we have 3mo run-rate showing sustained usage? Need that to justify rebaseline without big concession.

Samir Rao: Last 3 months: 280k, 310k, 325k. Stable growth. They said vendors are quoting 15% off list.

Evan Gomez: Margin check: list is $0.00065/token at 150k commit. If we give 15% at 320k blended rev drops significantly. Can we push 12% + POC fee?

Asha - Solutions: On-prem POC ok for 30 days. We require network diagram + SSO/KMS details. Ops cost estimated ~$5k.

security-bot: NexaHealth_security_q_v1 uploaded by Samir (link). Open items: KMS/HSM attestation, retention policy, export controls.

Samir Rao: Proposed counter to customer: commit 320k tokens/mo, 12% discount on committed tier, 12-month term, mid-year true-up (single downward adjustment allowed in year 1), 30d POC with $5k infra fee.

Finance (pricing): Approve up to 12% for >2x uplift with committee sign-off. $5k POC fee acceptable. Need Deal Desk ticket + margin calc.

Legal (triage): True-up clause language ok in principle. We'll draft final wording for quote.

Priya Shah: Please submit Deal Desk and tag @Finance (pricing) and @Legal (triage). I'll prep customer comms after we have approvals.

Evan Gomez: I'll attach the margin spreadsheet. If finance signs 12% and POC fee is accepted, I can finalize pricing.

Asha - Solutions: I'll start SOW for the POC and request customer network contacts.

Samir Rao: Action items: 1) Priya open Deal Desk (in flight), 2) Evan attach margins, 3) Asha draft SOW, 4) Legal finalize clause, 5) Security complete questionnaire. I'll send counter to customer tomorrow: 12% + POC fee + true-up guardrails.
